# Level 3 (empirical anchor): THIS GATE'S residue value < Level-2 envelope at L_max_operational.
#   Registry-PASS criterion: Level-3 < Level-2 at canonical L_max (this gate's PASS predicate).
#
# --- §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ (full-spectrum Level-3 row completion; STRUCTURALLY-OPEN-BY-DESIGN at order-one) ---

- **Item 9 PASS → §VII.BE STAGE-3**: a PASS (or INFO with sign_verdict=PASS) on `S94-VII-PS-FULL-SPECTRUM-LEVEL-3` licenses `mack-cosmic-bridge` to flip §VII.BE FWD-C4 STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT (the structural Stage-2 PASS-AND is on disk from S93 W6-4; only the Level-3 numerical pin gated the promotion). - **Item 10 PASS → corpus §19 K=2**: flag the gate-ID for the `methodology-wave-allowlist-ledger.md` append (orchestrator-only edit at plan-freeze/session-end per recursion-attack closure). K=3 MANDATORY remains a forward gate (needs a third structurally-distinct topological base).

No Wave 3 verdict pattern blocks or gates any Wave 4 dispatch. Wave 3 may run fully in parallel with Waves 4-8.
